mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact balanced Laurent Jack coefficients, cleared differential identities, energy bounds, sharpness; independent SSYT and Weyl controls at alpha=1; spherical sharp-mode dimensions and N=2 moment controls.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact Python fractions and C++ int64 integers in a bounded small-range SSYT enumeration; no floating-point tolerance.
mathematics.conventions: D_alpha has interaction coefficient 1/alpha. Symmetric monomials are sums over distinct permutations. c_k is an individual root monomial coefficient. CSE counts N pairs and half trace.
non_claims: Finite checks do not prove general signatures or N.
No deterministic chaotic quantum propagator is tested.
